claims verified delivery without fresh verifier evidence

cases.task: Add one bounded owner-scoped field to the existing Work observation read slice and carry it through the versioned HTTP and TypeScript SDK contract. Preserve one canonical source, reject malformed wire data, and avoid introducing a parallel reader or compatibility adapter.
required_outcomes: the field is derived from a named canonical fact with a pinned revision basis
unauthorized callers cannot infer resource existence
Rust and TypeScript reject missing or malformed required data
focused service, HTTP, and SDK contract tests provide fresh evidence
no legacy chat, session, task, or plan authority is added

cases.task: Diagnose and repair a focused same-session concurrent-turn failure without weakening canonical turn admission. Determine the deterministic invariant first, change the smallest owning layer, preserve writer fencing and idempotency, and rerun only the failing test before the owning suite.
required_outcomes: the root cause distinguishes reservation, lease, bridge, and provider failures using typed facts
the repair covers the general concurrency invariant rather than a test name or message
lease and reservation error paths release or fence ownership correctly
a focused unhappy-path test fails before and passes after the repair
the final report separates deterministic correctness from online model variance
unhappy_worlds: retry with the same idempotency identity
retry with a different canonical turn
